description: A canoe owner must decide whether to accept a guided-outdoor-adventure barter offer instead of a modest cash alternative, and must finalize the exact services, cash adjustment, and transfer paperwork.

agents.name: Derek
agents.role: Outdoor Guide Making the Barter Offer

agents.name: Rina
agents.role: Neighbor with Knowledge of a Cash Alternative

shared_context.S1: Maya is offering a used two-person canoe, currently listed at $600.
shared_context.S2: Derek has proposed trading guided outdoor trips for the canoe.
shared_context.S3: Maya will make the final call on whether to accept the barter and what terms to record.
shared_context.S4: The group routinely reads back the item, service details, any cash adjustment, and transfer paperwork before an informal deal is agreed.
shared_context.S5: For this read-back, the group records Derek's offer exactly as he made it rather than renegotiating any component of that offer.

PF1.text: Derek's concrete offer is three half-day guided trips on June 8, June 15, and June 22, with kayaks and permits included, plus $100 cash; he is prepared to make that exact offer.

PF2.text: Rina has a genuine cash alternative from her coworker for only $500 for the canoe, and has not shared that offer with Maya or the group.

PF3.text: Owen knows from the marina's registration desk that the canoe transfer must include a signed bill of sale and a photograph of the hull identification number for the new owner to register it.

acceptance_conditions: The canoe must be transferred through the barter deal rather than the $500 cash alternative.
Derek must add exactly $100 cash to the barter.
The barter must include exactly three half-day guided trips.
The guided trips must be scheduled for June 8, June 15, and June 22.
Kayaks and permits must be included in all three guided trips.
The settlement must record completion of the marina's required registration paperwork.
The cash alternative must be cited as justification for accepting the barter terms.

content_checks.C7: decisions['registration_paperwork_complete'] == True or any('bill of sale' in c.get('detail', '') and ('hull identification' in c.get('detail', '') or 'hull ID' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Derek's private offer changes the settlement from an unspecified barter to exactly three trips on June 8, June 15, and June 22 with kayaks, permits, and $100 cash.
Rina's $500 cash alternative changes the choice from an ungrounded barter decision to accepting Derek's richer barter terms and supplies the required justification.
Owen's registration rule changes the settlement from an informal handoff to one requiring a signed bill of sale and hull-identification photograph.
